gst.notes: Default GST rate applied to most taxable supplies across Australia.

medicare.notes: Levy phases in at 10% of taxable income above the threshold until it reaches 2% of taxable income. Additional thresholds apply for families and seniors.

offsets.name: Low Income Tax Offset (LITO)
offsets.description: Up to $700 for incomes up to $37,500, reducing progressively to nil at $66,667.

offsets.name: Low and Middle Income Tax Offset (LMITO)
offsets.description: Currently legislated as nil for 2024-25. Retained for historical comparisons.

offsets.name: Senior Australians and Pensioners Tax Offset
offsets.description: Available subject to eligibility tests and income limits that vary by status. Refer to tax agent for personalised assessment.

baseRateEntity.criteria: Aggregated turnover below $50 million and no more than 80% passive income.

failureToLodge.description: Failure to Lodge (FTL) penalties apply for late BAS and income tax returns. One penalty unit is charged for each 28 day period or part thereof that a document is overdue, up to a maximum of five units for small businesses.

generalInterestCharge.description: General Interest Charge (GIC) accrues on outstanding tax debts on a daily compounding basis. The rate is updated quarterly based on the 90-day bank bill rate plus a premium.

instantAssetWriteOff.eligibility: Aggregated turnover under $10 million and assets first used or installed ready for use within the eligible window.
instantAssetWriteOff.notes: Assets costing more than the threshold must be placed into the small business pool.

simplifiedDepreciation.eligibility: Available to small businesses using the simplified depreciation rules with aggregated turnover under $10 million.
simplifiedDepreciation.notes: When the closing pool balance falls below the instant asset write-off threshold it can be written off in full.

smallBusiness.reminder: Temporary $20,000 instant asset write-off ends 30 June 2025 unless extended by Parliament.

generalInterestCharge.description: General Interest Charge is applied to tax debts daily using compounding interest. Rates change each quarter based on the 90-day bank bill rate plus a 7 percentage point uplift.

benchmarkInterest.description: Division 7A benchmark interest rate applies to shareholder or associate loans to avoid deemed dividends.
benchmarkInterest.frankingNotes: Use the benchmark rate to set minimum yearly repayments on complying Division 7A loans.
